sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Gadobenate has been safely used in infants, so maternal use does not appear to pose a substantial risk to a breastfed infant. Guidelines developed by North American professional organizations state that breastfeeding need not be disrupted after a nursing mother receives a gadolinium-containing contrast medium.
Drug Levels and Effects > Drug Levels

Maternal Levels. The manufacturer reports that limited literature indicates that breastfeeding after gadobenate dimeglumine administration to the mother would result in the infant receiving an oral dose of 0.001%-0.04% of the maternal dose.
